That is Pillow's algorithm, except that the weights are int16 with as many fractional bits as the largest weight allows, where Pillow uses 22 bits. The Pillow port was 1-2 levels off on about 1% of the values of the d1-omni and LFM2.5-VL crops. RESIZE_ALGO_BILINEAR_TORCH rounds the weights of the Pillow port to that precision and scales them back to 22 bits, which gives the output of torchvision with the same passes, and "bilinear" maps to it for LFM2 and d1-omni. Forward all scale tensors at the three call sites, matching the pattern used by flint and the other NVFP4-capable MoE models.
